claims.claim: Reservation lemma: 2*|{v: degree(v)>=q}|-1 <= q implies an Alice win with q colors.
For a disjoint union of complete multipartite graphs, W_k implies W_q for every q>=k, including singleton parts.
There is no palette-monotonicity counterexample on at most five vertices.
The stated colorability, degree-count, and order restrictions are necessary for any counterexample.
